proposal_gold.txt.s: The project goal is to build a mobile app for campus events.
Deliverable: a push notification module for all students.
The admin dashboard feature will let organisers manage events.
Milestone 1 is design sign-off in week 2.
The team meets every Monday to review progress.
Priya is responsible for the backend services.
The payment scope is still unclear and may change the budget.
The vendor approval is still pending and the integration is delayed by two weeks.
A critical security vulnerability was found in the login module and it is not fixed.
One minor cosmetic bug was reported on the settings page.
The earlier crash on the signup screen has been fixed and verified.
The team is currently over budget on cloud hosting and costs may rise further.
Rahul is on leave next week, which may slow testing.
We might possibly need a third-party maps service later.
Documentation for the API is missing.

notes_gold.txt.s: Decision pending: choose between Firebase and OneSignal for notifications.
The deployment is blocked until the security team grants access.
Action: Priya to review the API schema by 2026-12-01.
Rahul will fix the login bug by 2026-12-04.
Meena to prepare the demo script before the review.
We discussed the sprint goals and agreed on priorities.
The unresolved question of data retention is still open.
Everything is on schedule and the team is happy.
The release is delayed again and the demo deadline will be missed.
The client demo is next Friday.
Design review is complete and approved by the client.
There is a risk that the database migration could fail in production.
The server is down and users cannot log in, which is a critical failure.
Waiting on the vendor to confirm pricing.
